email.subject: Quick fix for Mane Street Hair Studio's site
email.body:
Hi Marcus,

I took a look at Mane Street Hair Studio's website. Two things are likely costing you bookings:

There's no click-to-call button, so mobile visitors have to copy and dial your number manually instead of tapping to call. A lot of people just won't bother.

The footer also still shows outdated info, which can make new visitors unsure if you're still open or operating normally.

I run Northlight Web, a one-person shop that fixes exactly this kind of thing for a flat fee. Want a free 10-minute walkthrough where I show you what I found and how I'd fix it? No pressure either way.

Alex
